scope: Fixed immutable TTS PCM; three recognizers and three resampling paths, no synthesis or gate changes
interpretation: Both Parakeet and Qwen3 read every VoxCPM2 original/native CPU/GPU control exactly across all three paths; Nemotron remains recognizer-dependent and cannot alone establish audible synthesis repetitions.

OmniVoice legacy/cleanup cloning retains fox/dog substitutions in Nemotron and Parakeet at every sampler; Qwen3 reads the intended phrase. This does not certify cloning or justify replacing the unchanged primary gate.
Python linear interpolation aliases the tone; C ABI file loading uses miniaudio rather than the CLI Kaiser implementation and fails the diagnostic residual <.001 threshold at both rates.
Correcting resampling alone does not clear the failures. Official NVIDIA original-model/F16-Q4 fresh/reused diagnosis is GH 37902211301 at worker 397334025; results pending.
PR522 independently repairs Python array/WAV-helper aliasing and strided buffers; eight local tests pass, full shared-library/CI tests pending.

receipt.scope: Cross-recognize fixed TTS PCM and isolate resampling; not speech acceptance.
